name: Flikken Maastricht
description: Former Amsterdam police detective Floris Wolfs has been transferred to the police department of the south-Dutch country town Maastricht. His metropolitan experience nicely complements the local expertise of his new country colleagues, who know the folks. Slowly he fits in, while solving countless crimes together with his female partner Eva van Dongen.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: Eva and Wolfs have a new team manager: Donna Martina. Their past gets in the way of proper functioning. Especially if Donna refuses to listen when Wolfs and Eva notice that they are not the only ones having trouble with Donna.

videos.title: Murder at the gates of heaven
videos.overview: Against her will Eva starts working as a team leader, leaving Wolfs to solve a murder case alone. The victim is a mysterious man with a fake personality. To find out why he was murdered, Wolfs must discover who he is.

videos.title: The last day
videos.overview: While Floris Wolfs is being examined in the hospital after being knocked down by his son, Romeo is fighting for his life in the same hospital after being stabbed in the back. Meanwhile, Eva and Marion are assigned a new case: the disappearance of two vulnerable girls from an institution. There are fears they may have fallen into the hands of a violent loverboy organization.

videos.title: Rest in peace
videos.overview: A lavish funeral service is seized upon by a criminal group for an apparent settling of accounts within the underworld. Eva throws herself into the case together with Marion.

videos.title: Iron Rijn
videos.overview: Eva and Marion uncover a criminal organization with deep ramifications in the legitimate world. Despite significant opposition at the highest level, they manage to identify and successfully arrest both the perpetrators and the masterminds, thereby making a major contribution to the dismantling of the network and the restoration of law and order.

videos.title: Greed
videos.overview: When a metal prospector is violently killed, Eva and Marion are unwillingly drawn into the intriguing and usually hidden world of treasure hunters and metal fishermen. What initially appears to be a crime of passion soon proves to be more complex than expected. Meanwhile, Romeo's rehabilitation is nearing completion, and his return home is about to begin.

videos.title: The exorcist
videos.overview: Romeo is back at work with Marion, and together they are resolutely focusing on the investigation into a drug find in the lockers of a large company. As a result, Eva is left alone in a case involving a young woman found dead. Old demons are soon stirred up when it becomes clear that the victim was addicted. In response to this, Zitman intervenes and decides that Eva will be assigned a new partner.

videos.title: Confused man
videos.overview: Eva and her new partner Jeroen conduct their first investigation together: a dead neighbor is found on the doorstep of a young man with unexplained behavior. Everything points to a simple case, but Eva refuses to accept this. Meanwhile, Romeo and Marion are called to a shoplifting incident: a school student has stolen jewelry and refuses to speak to the police.

videos.title: Incel
videos.overview: An unexpected phone call puts Eva and Jeroen on the trail of a basement where a body is discovered that has lain there unnoticed for weeks. The discovery raises questions about the victim's identity and the circumstances surrounding his death. At the same time, Romeo and Marion receive valuable information about a suspicious van that may play a central role in a drug trafficking network. This clue could be crucial in uncovering a larger criminal connection and identifying those responsible for both cases. As the investigation unfolds, the two leads appear to become increasingly intertwined.

videos.title: At the very bottom
videos.overview: A young girl reports the sudden disappearance of her boyfriend. Because abuses surrounding labor migration are a priority for the agency and the missing man is a Polish worker, Zitman throws herself fully into the case. The investigation leads Eva and Jeroen into the shadowy world of temp agencies and exploitation. Meanwhile, Romeo and Marion have to deal with a remarkably compelling witness.

videos.title: Eindhoven
videos.overview: In Eindhoven, the discovery of a body in a dumpster has exposed a direct link to an ongoing police investigation. While the detective team examines this macabre find, officers Romeo and Marion are conducting a traffic stop elsewhere in the city. While stopping a vehicle for a traffic violation, they make a remarkable discovery: the young driver has not only flouted traffic rules but also turns out to be involved in a criminal organization active in the drug trade. This confluence of events sheds new light on the investigation and suggests possible connections between the two incidents.

videos.title: Bitcoins
videos.overview: Jeroen managed to resolve the case regarding the body in the container remarkably quickly, much to Eva's surprise. While he focused on the investigation, Romeo and Marion took on the care of Aya and Felix, the young couple who had previously been taken in by Eva at De Ponti and who now turned out to be on the run from an impending honor killing. Their situation brought an extra layer of urgency and tension, where protection and discretion were of vital importance to keep the young couple safe.

videos.title: Russian roulette
videos.overview: Now that Eva has discovered that Richard Steen is after Wolfs' inheritance, she does whatever it takes to track him down. However, Richard is on the run, hunted by both the police and the criminal syndicate to whom he is heavily in debt. When he is finally located in Maastricht, a series of bloodcurdling events unfolds that put the situation on edge. Meanwhile, Romeo and Marion manage to track down Aya's kidnappers. The crucial question remains whether they will be in time to prevent an honor killing.
